records.source: Oh... Hello! I'm Penny...
records.translation: Ah... Kumusta! Ako si Penny...

records.source: Oh! Is this for me? For... for my birthday?$3#$b#*sniff*... Sorry.$s#$b#I'm... just not used to such kindness...#$b#... I love it, though. It's perfect. Thank you so much.
records.translation: Oh! Para sa akin ba ito? Para... para sa kaarawan ko?$3#$b#*Singhot*... Paumanhin.$s#$b#Hindi lang... ako sanay sa ganitong kabaitan...#$b#... Pero gustung-gusto ko ito. Perpekto ito. Maraming-maraming salamat.

records.source: For my birthday? That's so nice of you! It's a great gift.$h
records.translation: Para sa kaarawan ko? Napakabait mo! Napakagandang regalo nito.$h

records.source: For my birthday? That's so kind of you! Let me unwrap it...$h#$b#...What!?$12#$b#...Oh, I see. It's a cruel joke.$s#$b#Silly me, I should've known better...$s
records.translation: Para sa kaarawan ko? Napakabait mo! Buksan ko ito...$h#$b#...Ano!?$12#$b#...Ah, nauunawaan ko na. Isa itong malupit na biro.$s#$b#Ako talaga, dapat ay alam ko na...$s

records.source: Oh... with me? Yes, of course!$h#$b#...Will you take the lead, though? I'm nervous...$12
records.translation: Ah... ako ang kasama mo? Oo, siyempre!$h#$b#...Pero ikaw ba ang mangunguna? Kinakabahan ako...$12

records.source: $y '@, what do you think... should a person be judged by their actions, or by their intentions?_Actions_Hmm... but don't we all make mistakes sometimes?$s_Intentions_Mmhmm... But what if you intend to do good, yet your actions cause harm?$s_Both_That's true... I guess it doesn't have to be one or the other. It might depend on the situation, too.'#$b#I was just wondering what you thought...
records.translation: $y '@, ano sa palagay mo... dapat bang hatulan ang isang tao batay sa kaniyang mga ginawa, o sa kaniyang mga hangarin?_Mga ginawa_Hmm... pero hindi ba nagkakamali tayong lahat kung minsan?$s_Mga hangarin_Mmhmm... Pero paano kung hangarin mong gumawa ng mabuti, ngunit nakapipinsala ang mga ginawa mo?$s_Pareho_Totoo iyan... Siguro ay hindi kailangang isa lang sa dalawa. Maaaring nakasalalay rin iyon sa sitwasyon.'#$b#Iniisip ko lang kung ano ang palagay mo...

records.source: Mmm... it's so fragrant. I'm going to love this.
records.translation: Mmm... napakabango nito. Tiyak na magugustuhan ko ito.

records.source: Wow... this looks really old. I'll have to ask Gunther about it. Thank you!$h
records.translation: Wow... mukhang napakatanda nito. Kailangan kong itanong ito kay Gunther. Salamat!$h

records.source: Thank you! I'm almost finished with a book right now, but I'll read this one next!$h
records.translation: Salamat! Malapit ko nang matapos ang binabasa kong aklat ngayon, pero ito ang susunod kong babasahin!$h

records.source: I've been teaching Jas and Vincent about Dwarvish Archaeology...#$b#Jas is curious about the origins of the Dwarves... but Vincent is mainly interested in dwarvish weapons!$h
records.translation: Tinuturuan ko sina Jas at Vincent tungkol sa Arkeolohiya ng mga Duwende...#$b#Nais malaman ni Jas ang pinagmulan ng mga Duwende... pero higit na interesado si Vincent sa mga sandatang Duwende!$h

records.source: Vincent has been asking me about slugs for weeks... so I prepared a whole lesson on them. They're actually pretty interesting!#$e#Whenever I see a banana slug, I feel like it's a sign of good luck.
records.translation: Ilang linggo nang nagtatanong sa akin si Vincent tungkol sa mga hubad na kuhol... kaya naghanda ako ng isang buong aralin tungkol sa mga iyon. Kawili-wili pala talaga sila!#$e#Tuwing nakakakita ako ng dilaw na hubad na kuhol, pakiramdam ko'y tanda iyon ng suwerte.

records.source: I'm teaching the kids about art history this week.#$b#It can be a little dry for the kids, so I'm having them learn by drawing a picture in the predominant style of each century.#$b#It's really been a hit!$h
records.translation: Tinuturuan ko ang mga bata tungkol sa kasaysayan ng sining ngayong linggo.#$b#Maaaring medyo nakababagot iyon para sa mga bata, kaya tinuturuan ko sila sa pamamagitan ng pagguhit ng larawan sa namamayaning estilo ng bawat siglo.#$b#Talagang nagustuhan nila iyon!$h

records.source: Oh, pardon this bandage on my hand...$s#$b#I went over to Maru's the other day and she showed me a new gadget of hers. The darn thing charred my palm!$s
records.translation: Oh, pagpasensiyahan mo ang benda sa kamay ko...$s#$b#Dumalaw ako kay Maru noong isang araw at ipinakita niya sa akin ang bago niyang aparato. Sinunog ng pesteng iyon ang palad ko!$s

records.source: I've been reading a book about the ocean. It accounts for most of the area of the world, and yet we hardly know anything about it!
records.translation: Nagbabasa ako ng aklat tungkol sa karagatan. Saklaw nito ang kalakhang bahagi ng ibabaw ng mundo, gayunman ay halos wala tayong alam tungkol dito!

records.source: I... I don't know what to say. I'm so happy...$l
records.translation: Hindi... Hindi ko alam ang sasabihin ko. Napakasaya ko...$l

records.source: Suddenly, the world looks a lot more beautiful, don't you think?
records.translation: Biglang naging mas maganda ang mundo, hindi ba?

records.source: I'm trying to finish this book, but I keep getting distracted thinking of you.$l
records.translation: Sinisikap kong tapusin ang aklat na ito, pero lagi akong nagagambala sa kaiisip sa iyo.$l

records.source: I never thought my life would be more exciting than a novel, but it sure feels that way right now!$h
records.translation: Hindi ko inakalang magiging mas kapana-panabik kaysa nobela ang buhay ko, pero talagang ganoon ang pakiramdam ngayon!$h

records.source: That was a beautiful wedding. I know Maru will make you very happy, she's a great person.
records.translation: Napakaganda ng kasal. Alam kong lubos kang paliligayahin ni Maru; napakabuti niyang tao.

records.source: Hi, @. Maru told me the news... I'm happy for you two!$h
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Sinabi sa akin ni Maru ang balita... Masaya ako para sa inyong dalawa!$h

records.source: This island is so beautiful!
records.translation: Napakaganda ng islang ito!

records.source: I had a great time.$h
records.translation: Talagang nagsaya ako.$h

records.source: Congratulations, @. Sam's a lot of fun, I'm sure you'll never have a dull moment!
records.translation: Binabati kita, @. Napakasayang kasama ni Sam; sigurado akong hindi ka kailanman mababagot!

records.source: I'm a little embarrassed wearing my bathing suit in public.$s#$b#I hope no one's looking...$s
records.translation: Medyo nahihiya akong nakasuot ng kasuotang panligo sa harap ng publiko.$s#$b#Sana ay walang nakatingin...$s

records.source: Somehow, the water here looks so different...#$e#I can hardly believe this is the same ocean I've been gazing at my entire life.
records.translation: Parang ibang-iba ang hitsura ng tubig dito...#$e#Halos hindi ako makapaniwalang ito rin ang karagatang minamasdan ko sa buong buhay ko.

records.source: The wind keeps making me lose my page, but it feels really great on the skin.$h
records.translation: Laging inililipat ng hangin ang pahinang binabasa ko, pero napakasarap ng dampi nito sa balat.$h

records.source: I'm reading a book about a sailor who washes up on a deserted island.#$b#I wonder what I would do in that sort of a situation?
records.translation: Nagbabasa ako ng aklat tungkol sa isang marinero na napadpad sa isang islang walang nakatira.#$b#Ano kaya ang gagawin ko sa ganoong sitwasyon?

records.source: Hey honey, do you mind standing a little to the left?#$b#Thanks, the sun was making it a little bit hard to read!$h
records.translation: Hoy, mahal, maaari ka bang tumayo nang kaunti sa kaliwa?#$b#Salamat, medyo mahirap magbasa dahil sa sikat ng araw!$h

records.source: This sand is so soft and fine. It feels great on my toes!$h
records.translation: Napakalambot at pino ng buhanging ito. Ang sarap sa mga daliri ng paa ko!$h

records.source: Hi... #$e#Oh, did you want something?
records.translation: Kumusta... #$e#Oh, may kailangan ka ba?

records.source: I accept!$h#$b#*whisper* Thanks for going through with the formalities, dear.
records.translation: Pumapayag ako!$h#$b#*Bulong* Salamat sa pagsunod sa mga pormalidad, mahal.

records.source: Oh... No, thanks.$s
records.translation: Oh... Hindi, salamat.$s

records.source: ...$s#$b#I... I see... *sniff* ... W... We can just be friends, then.$s
records.translation: ...$s#$b#Nau... Nauunawaan ko... *Singhot* ... M... Maaari na lang tayong maging magkaibigan.$s

records.source: What you did for my family is so generous. Thank you!
records.translation: Napakabukas-palad ng ginawa mo para sa pamilya ko. Salamat!

records.source: There are some truly wonderful people in the world...
records.translation: May mga tunay na kahanga-hangang tao sa mundo...

records.source: I can't bear to see you...$s
records.translation: Hindi ko maatim na makita ka...$s

records.source: ...Please, leave me alone.$s
records.translation: ...Pakiusap, pabayaan mo ako.$s

records.source: You've left a permanent scar on my heart, @. Still... I'm ready to speak to you again.$s
records.translation: Nag-iwan ka ng permanenteng peklat sa puso ko, @. Gayunman... handa na akong kausapin kang muli.$s

records.source: *sigh*... My mother definitely has a problem with going to the saloon too much.$s#$q 7/8 Mon_old#But it's best not to dwell on bad things, right?#$r 7 50 Mon_7#Right. It's best to be positive!#$r 8 10 Mon_8#I think it's good to be realistic.
records.translation: *Buntong-hininga*... Talagang may problema ang nanay ko sa sobrang pagpunta sa saloon.$s#$q 7/8 Mon_old#Pero mas mabuting huwag pag-isipan nang paulit-ulit ang masasamang bagay, hindi ba?#$r 7 50 Mon_7#Tama. Pinakamabuting maging positibo!#$r 8 10 Mon_8#Sa tingin ko'y mabuting maging makatotohanan.

records.source: #$p 7#But if I keep trying I think I can get her to change.|I guess it makes sense. There's not much I can do to change it, anyway.
records.translation: #$p 7#Pero kung patuloy kong susubukan, sa tingin ko'y mahihikayat ko siyang magbago.|Siguro ay may katuturan iyon. Wala rin naman akong gaanong magagawa upang baguhin iyon.

records.source: That's how I feel. I'm just going to focus on making the future better.
records.translation: Ganoon din ang pakiramdam ko. Magtutuon na lang ako sa pagpapabuti ng hinaharap.

records.source: Maybe you're right. It's better to cope with reality.$u
records.translation: Baka tama ka. Mas mabuting harapin ang realidad.$u

records.source: I'm eager to move out. It's such a burden to be worrying about Mom all the time.#$e#I want her to be happy, but I can't stay here forever... you know?$s
records.translation: Sabik na akong lumipat. Napakabigat sa loob ng laging pag-aalala kay Nanay.#$e#Gusto kong maging masaya siya, pero hindi ako maaaring manatili rito magpakailanman... alam mo?$s

records.source: I'm tutoring Vincent and Jas today... They're a handful, but it's nice to make a difference in someone's life.
records.translation: Tuturuan ko sina Vincent at Jas ngayon... Makulit sila, pero masarap sa pakiramdam ang may mabuting maidulot sa buhay ng iba.

records.source: $d bus#Maybe now that my mother has her bus driving job back, I can start saving more money. Things are looking a little brighter.|I'm trying to save money from my tutoring job, but it's hard with my mother out of work.$s
records.translation: $d bus#Ngayong nakabalik na ang nanay ko sa trabaho niyang pagmamaneho ng bus, baka makapagsimula akong mag-ipon ng mas maraming pera. Medyo gumaganda na ang kalagayan.|Sinisikap kong mag-ipon mula sa pagtuturo ko, pero mahirap dahil walang trabaho ang nanay ko.$s

records.source: Um, @? A farm seems like a good place for children, don't you think?$l#$e#It was just a thought I had.$l
records.translation: Um, @? Mukhang magandang lugar para sa mga bata ang bukid, hindi ba?$l#$e#Naisip ko lang iyon.$l

records.source: We don't have a school here but I'm doing my best to give Vincent and Jas a proper education.#$e#Every child deserves a chance to be successful.#$e#Jas is very good at math and reading. Vincent is good at... well, he has an active imagination!
records.translation: Wala tayong paaralan dito, pero ginagawa ko ang makakaya ko upang mabigyan sina Vincent at Jas ng wastong edukasyon.#$e#Karapat-dapat ang bawat bata sa pagkakataong magtagumpay.#$e#Napakahusay ni Jas sa matematika at pagbabasa. Mahusay naman si Vincent sa... aba, masigla ang imahinasyon niya!

records.source: You know what? I should take the children on a field trip some time. Maybe to the forest.#$e#A guest speaker would be nice... maybe someone familiar with nature?#$e#Sorry, I'm just thinking out loud.
records.translation: Alam mo? Dapat kong dalhin ang mga bata sa isang lakbay-aral balang araw. Baka sa kagubatan.#$e#Maganda rin kung may panauhing tagapagsalita... baka isang taong pamilyar sa kalikasan?#$e#Paumanhin, nag-iisip lang ako nang malakas.

records.source: Are you alright? We're all wondering what's going on...$3
records.translation: Ayos ka lang ba? Iniisip naming lahat kung ano ang nangyayari...$3

records.source: This strange weather is a good opportunity to get the kids interested in nature!$h
records.translation: Magandang pagkakataon ang kakaibang panahong ito upang pukawin ang interes ng mga bata sa kalikasan!$h

records.source: I've lived in Pelican Town my whole life. Can you believe that?#$e#I guess there's a lot out there I'll never experience.
records.translation: Buong buhay akong nanirahan sa Bayan ng Pelican. Makapaniwala ka ba?#$e#Siguro ay marami akong hindi kailanman mararanasan sa labas.

records.source: We're very lucky to have a library in such a small town.#$e#When you're lost in a book, it's easy to forget the realities of your life.$u#$e#...Maybe that's why I like reading so much.$s#$e#...Sorry. I got carried away there.
records.translation: Napakasuwerte nating may aklatan sa isang napakaliit na bayan.#$e#Kapag nalulubog ka sa isang aklat, madaling malimutan ang realidad ng buhay mo.$u#$e#...Siguro ay iyan ang dahilan kung bakit gustung-gusto kong magbasa.$s#$e#...Paumanhin. Nadala ako.

records.source: I wish I could keep a garden, but our yard is such a mess.$u#$e#Maybe I'll live in a place where I can have a garden someday.#$e#Maybe I'll live on a farm! *giggle*$h
records.translation: Sana ay makapag-alaga ako ng hardin, pero napakagulo ng bakuran namin.$u#$e#Baka balang araw ay manirahan ako sa lugar na maaari akong magkaroon ng hardin.#$e#Baka manirahan ako sa isang bukid! *Hagikgik*$h
